# Vendored dependencies

`pyJianYingDraft/` contains an adapted copy of [GuanYixuan's pyJianYingDraft](https://github.com/GuanYixuan/pyJianYingDraft), copyright 2024 GuanYixuan. It is distributed under the [Apache License 2.0](pyJianYingDraft/LICENSE).

The original JianYing Editor Skill adapted the library's draft templates and loading, timeline and material registration, caption and font handling, keyframes, and platform-specific editor integration. See the imported version described in [the provenance of this repository](../../docs/provenance.md). This community release carries forward the adapted library and adds its license text. The upstream excerpts in `references/` are covered by the same Apache license.
